edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the balance and event source consumed by transfer.
multiTransfer spends msg.sender funds through the internal transfer call.
approve stores an allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom checks the allowance granted by msg.sender.
increaseAllowance modifies the allowance entry of msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance modifies the allowance entry of msg.sender.
burn takes the burned account directly from msg.sender.
burnFrom consumes the allowance held by msg.sender.
constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
transfer executes the SafeMath balance arithmetic modelled by this unsafe operation.
transferFrom executes the SafeMath balance and allowance arithmetic modelled by this unsafe operation.
findOnePercentb performs the ceil, mul and div arithmetic modelled by this unsafe operation.
increaseAllowance performs the SafeMath add modelled by this unsafe operation.
decreaseAllowance performs the SafeMath sub modelled by this unsafe operation.
the internal mint routine performs the SafeMath add modelled by this unsafe operation.
the internal burn routine performs the SafeMath sub modelled by this unsafe operation.
burn delegates the actual accounting to the internal burn routine.
burnFrom delegates the actual accounting to the internal burn routine.
constructor calls the internal mint routine for the initial supply.
multiTransfer invokes transfer for every receiver and amount pair.
transfer reads and writes the sender and recipient balances.
transfer updates the total supply by the burn amount.
transferFrom reads and writes the source and destination balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
transferFrom updates the total supply by the burn amount.
approve writes the allowance entry for the caller and spender.
increaseAllowance adds to the caller allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the caller allowance.
the internal mint routine credits an account balance.
the internal burn routine debits an account balance.
the internal burn routine reduces the total supply.
burnFrom decrements the allowance of the caller.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowance mapping.
totalSupply reads the total supply state variable.
findOnePercentb consumes the basePercent constant in its arithmetic.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the transfer logic.
transfer amount parameter flows into the transfer logic.
receivers array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop.
spender parameter is stored by approve.
value parameter is stored by approve.
source address parameter flows into transferFrom.
destination address parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom.
spender parameter keys the allowance write in increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowance write in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
value parameter is rounded and scaled by findOnePercentb.
amount parameter is burned by burn.
account parameter selects the debited balance in burnFrom.
amount parameter is burned by burnFrom.
account parameter receives the minted balance.
amount parameter is credited by the internal mint routine.
account parameter is debited by the internal burn routine.
amount parameter is subtracted by the internal burn routine.
owner parameter indexes the balance lookup.
owner parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
transfer defines the local burn amount variable.
transfer defines the local transfer amount variable.
transferFrom defines the local burn amount variable.
transferFrom defines the local transfer amount variable.
findOnePercentb defines the rounded value local variable.
findOnePercentb defines the one percent result local variable.
multiTransfer defines the loop index local variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer logic and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Amount parameter is only meaningful inside transfer and should be merged into the transfer function node.
Receivers array is consumed solely by the multiTransfer loop.
Amounts array is consumed solely by the multiTransfer loop.
Spender parameter is used only as the allowance key in approve.
Value parameter is stored only by approve.
Source address parameter is used only by transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is used only by transferFrom.
Amount parameter is used only by transferFrom.
Spender parameter keys the allowance update performed by increaseAllowance.
Added value is the operand of the allowance addition modelled by this unsafe operation.
Spender parameter keys the allowance update performed by decreaseAllowance.
Subtracted value is the operand of the allowance subtraction modelled by this unsafe operation.
Input value is only rounded inside findOnePercentb.
Amount parameter is forwarded by burn and has no independent role.
Account parameter selects the debited balance in burnFrom.
Amount parameter is only used by burnFrom.
Account parameter is credited solely by the internal mint routine.
Amount parameter is the operand of the balance addition modelled by this unsafe operation.
Account parameter is debited solely by the internal burn routine.
Amount parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction modelled by this unsafe operation.
Owner parameter is only an index into the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
Owner parameter is only part of the allowance lookup key.
Spender parameter is only part of the allowance lookup key.
Local burn figure is hardcoded to zero and only meaningful inside transfer.
Local transfer figure is a temporary derived solely inside transfer.
Local burn figure is hardcoded to zero and only meaningful inside transferFrom.
Local transfer figure is a temporary derived solely inside transferFrom.
Rounded value is an intermediate of the rounding arithmetic modelled by this unsafe operation.
One percent result is the output of the rounding arithmetic modelled by this unsafe operation.
Loop counter exists only to drive the multiTransfer iteration.
